findings.title: Rollback copies omit non-interactive force flag
findings.why_it_matters: The installer performs these copies during transaction snapshot and rollback. Omitting the repository-required force flag can allow an interactive `cp` configuration to pause an unattended install or rollback for confirmation, which is exactly the hang the project standard is intended to prevent.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `-f` while preserving metadata at both sites, for example `cp -fp "$source_path" "$snapshot_path"` and `cp -fp "$ROLLBACK_DIR/$snapshot_name" "$destination"`, then rerun the installer test.
evidence: AGENTS.md:26-41, Non-Interactive Shell Commands: `ALWAYS use non-interactive flags with file operations` and `cp -f source dest`; the stated reason is that `cp`, `mv`, and `rm` may be aliased to interactive mode and hang waiting for confirmation.
scripts/install-agent-integrations.sh:341 invokes `cp -p "$source_path" "$snapshot_path"` without `-f` while snapshotting client configuration.
scripts/install-agent-integrations.sh:366 invokes `cp -p "$ROLLBACK_DIR/$snapshot_name" "$destination"` without `-f` while restoring client configuration.
